title: Transcript recovery adversarial suite + first real large-corpus pilot

source_provenance.notes: Current baseline covers 5 narrow deterministic tests

problem_or_opportunity: The current extractor has 5/5 exact-source smoke tests but lacks nested-quote, malformed-role, markdown/code, multilingual, fake-artifact, huge-input, multi-project, connector reconciliation and concurrency evidence. No real large pasted-corpus recovery pilot has yet been recorded.
proposed_mechanism: Build a bounded adversarial fixture suite and a first-real-corpus run card measuring material-item coverage/disposition, false authority promotion, secret persistence, duplicate creation, frontier accuracy, stale-write handling, readback and Founder questions. Feed actual pilot observations to Learning Ledger and improvement candidates.
expected_benefit: Converts transcript recovery from narrow unit-test confidence into operational evidence while preserving strict evidence separation.
next_action: Execute N17-N24 and N49-N56 selectively; create adversarial fixtures and exact first-real-corpus pilot run card. Run real pilot only when Founder actually supplies a long pasted old conversation.
notes: BOUNDED PILOT B under ANTI-BEDLAM. Real large-corpus evidence cannot be fabricated before an actual transferred conversation is provided.
